title: Early Brief: U.S.-Canada relations go up in smoke
description: There’s been something in the air in D.C. this summer — namely wildfire smoke and frustration over Canada’s inability to keep it on its side of the border.

title: Why Republicans could still keep control of the House
description: Democrats are ahead in polls, and voters typically punish the party that controls the White House during midterms. But Republicans have several paths to maintaining power.

title: Celebrity culture is one thing. For TMZ, Congress is the new 'reality show'
description: TMZ is trading Hollywood gossip for Capitol Hill scoops with a new D.C. bureau, launched in April. The online tabloid's two-man crew has brought an unconventional reporting style to the Congress beat.

title: Senate Finance Committee wrestles with how to sustain Social Security benefits
description: The Senate Finance Committee held a hearing yesterday on how to prevent deep cuts to Social Security benefits in a few years. The math is simple but the politics are not.

title: Trump touts economy during Vegas speech, but workers say his policies aren't helping
description: President Trump gave a speech in Las Vegas Wednesday, where he praised the U.S. economy but workers in the city say his administration's policies aren't helping.

title: Senate committee set to vote on whether to hold Fauci in contempt of Congress
description: Republicans on the Senate Homeland Security Committee want to hold Fauci in contempt of Congress after he refused to answer their questions about the government's response to the COVID-19 pandemic.

title: GOP senator obtains a copy of Fauci’s phone as contempt vote looms
description: Sen. Ron Johnson (Wisconsin) said the phone could address many questions that Fauci declined to answer at a hearing about the pandemic last week.

title: Rep. Edwards drops competitive reelection bid after House censure recommendation
description: An Ethics Committee report detailed “persistent unprofessional and inappropriate conduct” by the North Carolina Republican toward two young female staffers.

title: Lawsuit over Missouri’s congressional map could throw a wrench into midterms
description: If the court approves the request for a referendum, it could raise questions about whether Tuesday’s primary winners under the new map are the official nominees.

title: El-Sayed gives progressives another victory and a new challenge
description: In Michigan’s primaries, the most progressive candidates won out, extending their movement into the Rust Belt and setting up a major test in November.

title: Government watchdog still can’t identify who all worked for DOGE
description: Over a year after Elon Musk left the government, it remains unclear who was in DOGE and if they understood ethics rules.

title: Michigan Senate primary shows Democratic establishment has lost its grip
description: The upset highlighted how out of touch the power brokers are with the party’s surging left wing as they try to retake control of the Senate.

title: This chaplain may become first trans person elected to Michigan legislature
description: Joanna Whaley is favored to win the heavily Democratic district in November.

title: Why there’s so much heat on Anthony Fauci right now
description: Public health experts have a few theories.

title: Why did the polls miss so badly in Michigan?
description: Polls overestimated Abdul El-Sayed’s lead by 12 percentage points. That isn't unusual for statewide primary contests.

title: Democrats ask Interior watchdog to investigate response to Reflecting Pool damage
description: Sens. Whitehouse and Heinrich say the inspector general must probe the agency’s internal documents after Justice Department officials said Interior concealed information about damage to the pool’s renovations.

title: How El-Sayed won the contentious Michigan Senate Democratic primary
description: Abdul El-Sayed won with a populist platform buoyed by voter discontent with establishment Democrats and Israel.

title: Democrats turn out big in Michigan gubernatorial primary
description: About 1.5 million voters cast ballots in the Democratic primary for governor compared with about 930,000 in the Republican primary, as of midday Wednesday.

title: Trump-endorsed candidate loses to Michigan man who dropped out of race
description: Thomas J. Smith suspended his campaign for Michigan’s 8th District. Yet he is projected to beat Amir Hassan, a rival backed by the president.

title: The local impact of changing federal grant rules
description: Democratic policy makers are pushing back on a rule change proposed by the Office of Management and Budget that would grant political appointees veto power over federal research grants. We talk with people at the level of local government about what this could mean for them in areas like public health and research.

title: Speaker Johnson says Ethics Committee should carry out Max Miller investigation
description: The Ohio Republican congressman has faced calls to drop his reelection bid over domestic abuse allegations.

title: Takeaways from a big primary night in Michigan, Kansas, Missouri and more
description: Abdul El-Sayed won Michigan's hotly contested Democratic Senate primary. Democratic ideological battles ended in mixed results in House primaries.

title: How Trump made an estimated $2.2 billion during the first year of his second term
description: New York Times reporter Eric Lipton discusses his Pulitzer Prize-winning investigations into Trump's conflicts of interest and whether he's exploiting the power of the presidency for self-enrichment.

title: Judge reluctantly dismisses case against Oath Keepers militia group over Jan. 6 riot
description: A judge has granted the Justice Department's bid to drop a landmark case against leaders of the Oath Keepers, as former prosecutors warn about the dangers of denying the violence of Jan. 6.

title: Tennessee’s Republican governor endorses challenge to sitting GOP congressman
description: Gov. Bill Lee just endorsed against Trump-backed Rep. Andy Ogles, a fellow Republican, ahead of the Thursday election.

title: El-Sayed wins Michigan primary, setting up crucial Senate race
description: In today’s edition … the Senate has a long to-do list before leaving town ... a mysterious source of cheap gas … but first …

title: Progressive Abdul El-Sayed wins Michigan's Democratic primary for Senate
description: El-Sayed, an epidemiologist, backs Medicare for all and decries corporate money in politics. He beat Rep. Haley Stevens, whose supporters said she would have had a better chance in the fall.

title: 5 states went to the polls Tuesday. Takeaways from the primary elections
description: Five states held primary elections Tuesday that could play a decisive role in which party controls Congress in the midterm elections. A look at the results and the race that's too close to call.

title: Progressives see biggest win yet in Michigan, while Trump flexes power over GOP
description: Progressives notched major wins in Michigan, while voters in Missouri and Washington rejected insurgent Democrats. Meanwhile, Trump continued to flex his influence over the Republican Party.

title: Judge dismisses Jan. 6 seditious conspiracy charges against Oath Keepers
description: While taking the last step in the legal process to wipe out penalties from the Capitol riot, the judge also criticized the Justice Department for undoing the most serious convictions.

title: Democrat exits Senate race in South Dakota, clearing way for independent
description: Julian Beaudion withdrew after resisting pressure to step aside, making South Dakota’s contest the third Senate race without a Democratic candidate.

title: Who’s winning in California v. Trump lawsuits so far?
description: The White House calls California’s suits ‘frivolous’ amid court battles.

title: Here’s what to watch for in Tuesday’s primaries
description: After a few weeks of relative calm on the midterms calendar, we’ve got a slate of states with important primaries across the country today.
